intent: A formal sculpture garden of the Eternal Domain: a clipped-turf court in a raised gold-beddded parterre, a rill of still gold water down the allée, pale gods on plinths and gold-leaved trees about a colossal heart, with its own statue, lamp and urn sculpts and petals of holy light sifting down over the court.

critic.best_shot: feature-shots-final: tall statue up the gold allée
critic.why: A proper formal parterre; turf and gold beds keep it cultivated. The statue is a little thin.

notes:
# P

Keep: Keep the turf squares, gold beds and cross allée.

1. Make the central statue more colossal with a clear head and gesture.
2. Clip the trees to cones or balls so nothing reads wild.
3. Add the gold rill to every seed; it is the best line in the plan.
